name: Love In The New Testament
overview: The New Testament reveals love as a central, Christ-exalting command that surpasses all other affections, as Jesus teaches that no earthly relationship should exceed our love for Him. God's love is supremely demonstrated in the giving of His only Son for the salvation of the world, calling believers to respond by loving one another with the same selfless devotion. Genuine love is evidenced by obedience to Christ's commandments and a refusal to harbor hatred even toward enemies, reflecting the transformative power of His grace in our relationships.
